title: Accommodation
subtitle: Recommended Hotels Near THE PARK Hyderabad
intro: Comfortable accommodation options within convenient reach of the conference venue.

hotels.name: THE PARK Hyderabad
hotels.description: The conference venue itself, THE PARK Hyderabad is a luxury five-star boutique hotel overlooking Hussain Sagar Lake. It offers contemporary rooms and suites, multiple dining options, a swimming pool, spa and business facilities, making it the most convenient accommodation option for delegates attending the conference.

hotels.name: Katriya Hotel & Towers
hotels.description: A convenient accommodation option on Raj Bhavan Road, Somajiguda. The hotel offers full-service facilities including restaurants, banquet spaces, parking and comfortable rooms, making it suitable for conference delegates.

hotels.name: Mercure Hyderabad KCP
hotels.address: 6-3-551, Banjara Hills Main Road, Somajiguda, Hyderabad – 500082
hotels.description: A centrally located 4-star hotel with spacious rooms, dining options, fitness facilities, Wi-Fi and business amenities. Its Somajiguda/Banjara Hills location makes it a practical choice for conference and business travellers.

hotels.name: Hotel Inner Circle
hotels.description: Located in the heart of Somajiguda, this hotel offers comfortable rooms, Wi-Fi, parking, dining and business facilities. Its Raj Bhavan Road location is convenient for delegates staying close to the conference venue.

hotels.name: Holiday Inn Express Hyderabad Banjara Hills
hotels.address: 6-3-563/2nd Floor/A, Erramanzil Colony, Somajiguda, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad – 500082
hotels.description: A modern and practical option for business and conference travellers, with comfortable rooms, complimentary breakfast, Wi-Fi, a fitness centre, self-service laundry and convenient access to Somajiguda and Banjara Hills.

hotels.name: Hyderabad Marriott Hotel & Convention Centre
hotels.description: A premium five-star option overlooking Hussain Sagar Lake, offering upscale accommodation, restaurants, fitness facilities, pool and business amenities. A good choice for delegates seeking a premium stay in central Hyderabad.
